title: The Prototype Drive
logline: An erratic propulsion architect develops an unshielded pulse-resonance drive that blind-scrambles gate navigation across adjacent systems, attracting corporate repossession gunboats.

roles.description: A brilliant, erratic propulsion architect constructing an unchartered drive in an asteroid cradle.
Regulates jump gate beacon synchronization; terrified of undocumented harmonic frequencies.
A relentless industrial recovery agent hunting patent infringement across jump corridors.
A sleek test vessel fitted with an unshielded pulse-resonance thruster bell.
A heavy security patrol craft armed with pulse disruptors and corporate salvage grapnels.
A hollowed nickel asteroid converted into an unlisted propulsion test cradle.
The navigation and relay hub anchoring gate transit lanes in a neighbouring system.
An independent fraternity of custom hull builders struggling under megacorporate engine patent monopolies.

public_situation: Unregistered engine tests in rim sectors are sending harmonic interference pulses that disrupt jump gate telemetry across multiple systems.
private_truth: The prototype drive does not just violate patents; its harmonic pulse desynchronizes gate transit beacons, making mass jump travel unstable.

beats.public_change: The shipwright guild posts an urgent requisition for regulated thorium fuel rods to initiate a test firing.

missions.reason: She needs sealed thorium ignition canisters couriered through sector checkpoints without triggering commercial reactor permits.
missions.private_fact: She knows the drive design was stolen from her former employer when they canceled her independent safety program.

beats.public_change: The test firing triggers a cascade of navigation dropouts, causing gate relays in adjacent systems to fail safe into lockdown.

missions.reason: He needs a pilot to scan the transit gate's sensor arrays in the next system to determine what triggered the relay blackout.
missions.private_fact: He concealed initial reports of gate drift to avoid triggering an audit of his sector's maintenance budget.

beats.public_change: Corporate recovery agents arrive at the gate hub with repossession warrants, tracking the drive's unique ionization trail.

missions.reason: He needs the prototype's raw emission logs couriered to a secure regulator vault before corporate recovery agents seize them.
missions.private_fact: The logs prove the gate network itself was built with vulnerable legacy frequencies that the corporation knew about for decades.

player_choice.prompt: The logs show the drive renders corporate patents obsolete but risks tearing down gate stability sector-wide.

options.label: Deliver the corporate tracking vectors to the renegade shipwright to help her jump out
Sell the telemetry coordinates to the corporate retriever for an executive bounty
Deliver the evidence to the commissioner to issue a permanent sector quarantine on the drive

beats.public_change: Corporate interceptors box in the prototype vessel in deep space as it attempts an emergency warp calibration burn.

missions.reason: She needs the corporate tracking transponder blown off the interceptor hull and recovered so she can scramble their search grid.
missions.private_fact: Her test vessel's containment field is leaking, and she will have to vent her reactor if she cannot jump immediately.

beats.public_change: The interceptor fleet regroups at the asteroid slipway to destroy the prototype before its blueprints can be broadcast.

missions.reason: She needs the lead interceptor destroyed at the slipway threshold so she can upload the drive schematics to open data buoys.
missions.private_fact: She knows broadcasting the plans will invite hundreds of amateur builders to construct unstable drives across the stars.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the corporate interceptor and helps the shipwright broadcast the drive plans.
resolutions.summary: The drive schematics are broadcast across open frequencies. {role:shipwright_guild} gains access to radical propulsion tech, while gate authorities scramble to patch transit sensors.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot defended a renegade yard and broadcast blueprints for a drive that broke corporate patents.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the coordinates to the retriever or abandons the shipwright.
resolutions.summary: Corporate security impounds {role:prototype_cutter} and seals the blueprints in private vaults. {role:renegade_shipwright} is discredited while corporate patent dominance remains absolute.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot hands evidence to the commissioner, who legally outlaws the propulsion frequency.
resolutions.summary: {role:gate_commissioner} seals the prototype under safety quarantine. The test data is buried to safeguard gate integrity, leaving both the guild and corporate hunters empty-handed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never engages or scans fail to isolate the resonance source.
resolutions.summary: Resonant pulses from unshielded drive tests trip automated safety cutoffs across regional gates, stranding convoys and closing commercial lanes for weeks.

loose_threads.detail: The prototype magnetic coils were wound from exotic alloys purchased under a shell company fronting for a major logistics bank.
Gate sensor telemetry shows harmonic dropouts recurring at exact forty-minute intervals matching automated patrol schedules.

radio_hooks: Navigation authorities investigate anomalous harmonic pulses causing gate telemetry flickers.
Corporate security vectors heavy patrol vessels into rim sectors on intellectual property sweeps.
Independent yard workers celebrate rumored breakthrough in sublight thruster efficiency.

voice_direction.renegade_shipwright: Passionate, fast, and defensive. Talks in intricate mathematical metaphors and treats administrative objections as intellectual cowardice.
voice_direction.gate_commissioner: Tired, anxious, and rigid. Repeatedly emphasizes transit safety statistics and avoids acknowledging that gate hardware is decades past its design life.
voice_direction.corporate_retriever: Smooth, polite, and unhurried. Uses corporate legal euphemisms for physical enforcement and speaks with quiet certainty of eventual repossession.
